title: Softening an Objection: eso sí, de todos modos, ahora bien
goal: Accept something and soften the objection with eso sí, de todos modos and ahora bien.
grammar: eso sí, de todos modos, ahora bien

items: I can use *eso sí* to accept something and add a condition.
I can use *de todos modos* to say that nothing changes.
I can use *ahora bien* to add a limit to what I accepted.
